options.name: extend flow-export CLI
options.reason: violates the CLI's own frozen single-artifact contract (FORBIDDEN_KEYS bans signature/approval/trust keys); breaks the Web runner's allowlisted-commit compatibility posture

options.name: separate package CLI composing existing producers
options.reason: zero duplication (reuses flow-export producer, existing sealed bundles, verifyBundle, verify-manifest signing primitives); clean authority boundaries; repo one-thin-CLI-per-job convention; deterministic and testable like the flow-export CLI; composes into Web runner and future desktop shells

options.name: extend runOneShot
options.reason: Lens session lineage (shadow-lens-session/1.0, not shadow-flow-export/1.0), HTTP surface, writes no files by design, live mode needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ephemeral demo signing

options.name: package mode on the verifier
options.reason: conflates producer and verifier; the verification boundary's independence is the design's core asset; verifier may later READ packages, never produce them

options.name: standalone packaging library + thin CLIs
options.reason: manifest primitives already exist in verify/verify-manifest.mjs; extract packages/package-core only when a second in-process consumer (desktop/Tauri, Web build) exists

consumer_rules: two-way completeness (reject missing AND unlisted members)
re-derive verification; disagreement is a display state

next_increment: package CLI in fixture mode per NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_INCREMENT.md; no Web changes; no existing-contract changes
